verdicts.quote: No failure writes a partial batch.
Row errors identify logical CSV record numbers, counting the header as 1, when applicable.
verdicts.missing: Whether the response lists every failing record and gives the specific reason for each failure.

verdicts.quote: Existing and within-file email comparisons are case-insensitive. A conflict returns 409. No failure writes a partial batch.
The baseline has no write endpoint or role model (src/server.js and src/users.js at ec1f94c). A configured server-side bearer token identifies an admin for this operation.
Accept name and email headers in either order, with case and surrounding whitespace normalized.
verdicts.missing: Whether an additional column alongside name and email is rejected or ignored.

verdicts.quote: CSV supports CRLF and LF, a UTF-8 BOM, escaped quotes and quoted commas/newlines.
decodes and validates records, commits synchronously, and responds.
verdicts.missing: Whether invitations or other external effects are deferred until commit, and what happens to any already issued if a later row fails.

verdicts.quote: Accept up to and including 256 KiB and 1,000 data records. Exceeding either returns 413.
Bad headers, malformed CSV or UTF-8, empty imports, a blank name or an email without one @ and a dotted domain return 400.
Replaying hits the existing email conflict at record 2 and leaves five records.
operator sends a completed file, server authorizes, checks media and bounds, decodes and validates records, commits synchronously, and responds.
verdicts.missing: The HTTP response signals synchronous completion. The specification explicitly excludes background processing, so there is no completion notice for a background job.
Where the bytes reside during processing, when they are discarded, and whether anyone can retrieve the upload.

verdicts.quote: incomplete or rejected request leaves the user store as observed before this request. Caller can correct and resend.
verdicts.missing: How an admin cancels an in-flight import and whether the service supports a retry restricted to failed rows.

verdicts.quote: No throughput or hosted availability commitment is defined.
verdicts.missing: A completion-time bound for a maximum-size import and what progress the admin can see before the response arrives.

verdicts.quote: A successful batch appends users with unique increasing numeric IDs in file order.
verdicts.missing: The append and conflict rules preserve existing users. R-1 describes a baseline with no write endpoint, and the specification gives no manual creation workflow to preserve.

verdicts.quote: Error responses omit raw row data and credentials.
verdicts.missing: Omitting raw row values keeps formulas out of row errors. The specification gives no field-length limit or behavior for an oversized field within the overall file limit.
